title: The All’s Eye Trio breakout with an electrifying new single, “West Hill Road”
htmlContent:
The All’s Eye Trio, invites listeners on an exciting seven minute journey with their new single, “West Hill Road.” This track combines high-energy music and stunning improv, featuring the talents of Ari Joshua on guitar, Kris Yunker on keys, and Ben Atkind on drums. It’s like taking a sonic road trip, where the sounds constantly shift and surprise.

Yunker’s bright keyboard melodies set the mood, creating a colorful musical backdrop. Joshua’s guitar adds a lively touch, blending soulful riffs with cosmic sounds, while Atkind’s precise drumming keeps everything moving with a rhythm that makes you want to dance. Yunker and Atkind have experience in the jam band scene, having played with Goose, a popular band in the genre. However, The All’s Eye Trio is creating its own unique sound.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6YGJEhTOYeZY03ESyIRLve?si=08b3f847d2ed46c8

“West Hill Road” showcases the group’s ability to work together, balancing well-structured songs with moments of thrilling improvisation. The trio is preparing for a tour, ready to bring their studio magic to live performances. Fans can look forward to extended musical jam sessions and spontaneous musical moments. The All’s Eye Trio is just beginning their exciting journey, and there’s much more to come.
